component.name: Astrometrics
component.summary: Modern astronomical image viewer, analyzer, and observatory control suite

description.p: Astrometrics is a high-performance astronomy application designed for telescope control, observatory automation, planetarium celestial tracking, FITS image inspection, and spectroscopy analysis.

ul.li: Interactive WebGL-powered 60 FPS celestial sky map and star catalog.
INDI and Alpaca telescope mount, focuser, and camera control.
Sub-pixel star detection, FITS plate-solving, stacking, and photometry.
Live multi-monitor observing workspaces with system tray quick telemetry.

description.p: Ubuntu 26.04 Wayland enhancements, AppStream metadata, native XDG thumbnailer, and platform adapter architecture.
